notes.title: SpeedRunners 2 News: Open Playtest Launches!
notes.content:
[quote][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4468079/da0190ffa927896fc5d844a2b475af0c34f42994.gif[/img][/quote]
[h1][b]The Open Playtest Is Here![/b][/h1]

If you've previously signed up for participation, check your inbox for an email with instructions. If you haven't signed up, do so right now on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3183760/SpeedRunners_2_King_of_Speed/]sequel's Steam page[/url]! Please keep in mind that we will be inviting players in waves (meaning not everyone at once), so if you weren't in the first wave, please be patient: your email should arrive shortly.

[previewyoutube=6qTyaQd7Y3Y;full]TRAILER EMBED[/previewyoutube]
[i][b]SpeedRunners 2[/b][/i] is a perfect game to play with your friends. When you receive that invitation by email, you'll be able to invite up to three buddies to run with you, so make sure to do that!

[b]Now, it's a time for a very important disclaimer:[/b] This is the first version of [i][b]SpeedRunners 2[/b][/i] we are sharing with the public, so everything is subject to change as we keep developing the game; so please forgive us at least some of the bugs and issues you might encounter! We wholeheartedly believe that the gameplay of SpeedRunners is timeless and unique, and we want the sequel to be attractive and accessible for new players while at the same time keeping all the little things that made SpeedRunners special for players who have known and loved it for a long time. We are going to carefully consider all your feedback (which you can fill in [url=https://forms.gle/mUBysjwqT4w1YnC66]this form[/url] or share in [url=https://discord.gg/speedrunnersgame]our Discord[/url] or on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3730770/discussions/1/]Steam forums[/url]), and work hard on the game to make it live up to all expectations. For the Open Playtest, most of the familiar modes would be available, while at the same time, we are introducing a couple of brand new modes that we always wanted to do for SpeedRunners 1, but weren't able to due to engine/netcode limitations. Let's go into more detail on that.

[h3][b]NEW MODES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]🏆 [b]Tournament Mode[/b]: an ultimate SpeedRunners battle royale! 64 contenders and only one champion. Make your way from the Round of 16 to the Finals, outrun others, and come out on top.
[quote][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577677/46d2d6c173cae60407e516b7edd14ef62a9027ac.gif[/img][/quote][*] 🏃 [b]8-Players Mode[/b]: Online casual competition for up to 8 people, chaotic but very fun![/list]
We would appreciate it if you tried out these new modes and shared your feedback with us. Now, let us review the classic stuff that already made its way to the playtest.

[h3][b]CLASSIC MODES [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] 🥇 Ranked: Earn points & climb the ranks.
[*] 🚀 Quick Match: Outrun other players in casual best-of-three runs.
[*]🎮 Local Versus: Ruin your relationship with friends in couch multiplayer.😬 You can also train against bots of varying difficulty in this mode.
[*] 🚪 Custom Lobby: Create your own public or private lobby or join an existing one.
[*]🎯 Practice mode for solo runs and training. There's a basic tutorial for first-timers and a selection of advanced tutorials to teach you complex techniques.
[/list]
[h3][b]RUNNERS[/b][/h3]
Let us be clear: we think all the runners from the original game are awesome. Your favorites will be coming back and eventually getting their spotlight. Still, we had to prioritize it. So, for our Open Playtest, here's what you're getting:
[list]
[*][img src={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577677/d200383f44798f9df397df69e5815402d6e218b0.png][/img]SpeedRunner 
[*][img src={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577677/9ecb538bbad76d466c3d8e4b91969330f1f5af81.png][/img] Cosmonaut Comrade
[*][img src={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577677/a2ce81feacf4a2879820b7f4c3a8318f753e8f75.png][/img] Hothead
[*][img src={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577677/18e3edeb82c634a4ad6fe3004c91ffb436ffa5c8.png][/img] Moonraker
[*][img src={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577677/5794934fea4a75fd16d61e7501d690d5652f8f64.png][/img] Unic
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577677/8f0ffe66f5e41fc458faa1a70a204080b5afadb8.png[/img] [i]Surprise![/i] A wild Maneki Neko appears![/list][quote]
[img src={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577677/0ee6cbc712700a7fb9f5282bc3f1b077710f6f1b.jpg][/img][/quote]Yes, she has definitely changed. We've given her a new look to match the sequel's upgraded visuals and vibe, so it's safe to say that's Maneki Neko 2.0 for you right there! Let us know what you think about the new design in the comments.

[h3][b]MAPS[/b][/h3]
Eventually, our goal is to bring all of the most beloved [i][b]SR 1[/b][/i] maps to [i][b]SR 2[/b][/i], and some of the best officials are already available. To spice it up a little, every map is going to have an alternative layout for you to learn! Here's the list of maps you get to play during the Open Playtest:
[list]
[*] Ⓜ️ [b]Metro[/b] (Layouts A & B)
[*] 🎰 [b]Casino[/b] ((Layouts A & B)
[*] 🚢 [b]SS Royale[/b] (Layouts A & B)
[*] ...and a brand new official map called [b]Museum[/b] (Layouts A & B apply to it as well)
[/list][quote][img src={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577677/bc50cad8a96ba0c37e63e1906791ba8f6e070451.png][/img][/quote][hr][/hr]There you have it, speedrunners! Enjoy the game and please, [i]*please!*[/i] send us feedback on how it plays. Report bugs [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3730770/discussions/3/]here[/url] and share your thoughts [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3730770/discussions/1/]on this subforum[/url] or on our Discord server, the link to which is below.👇

[img src={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798338/331da3fedae4d38863e6882991dea76fffc86264.gif][/img]

Our dev crew will be [b]streaming the game live[/b] on Discord today (Sep 19) from 7:15 pm CET/10:15 am PT until 8 pm CET/11 am PT, so feel free to hop on. Apart from that, we're planning on holding a [b]community playtest tournament[/b] tomorrow, September 20th, at 6 pm CET/9 am PT: Some of the best [i][b]SpeedRunners[/b][/i] players literally [i]of all time [/i]will be competing, so you don't want to miss that. It'll be streamed live on tinyBuild's [url=https://www.youtube.com/@tinyBuildGAMES]YouTube channel[/url].

Consider supporting us by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3183760/Speedrunners_2_King_of_Speed][b]wishlisting the game[/b][/url]; also, follow our Steam page to keep up with the news.

We will be hosting a map remix contest beginning in May and more details will be announces and a vote held between now and then. Keep your eyes peeled for that!

[h3]Last but not least...[/h3] I'd like to [b]thank the community[/b] for supporting our efforts to keep this game alive and your hard work and support is about to be rewarded. Please tune in for the [b]special[/b] stream if you can. It's gonna be worth your time. <3

As always, I'm your [b]VOLUNTEER[/b] Community Manager. 
Good Night and Good Luck.
-TheSilentChaos

notes.title: Last Call for Mapmaker Contest and The Future of Learner's League
notes.content:
Hello Everyone. TheSilentChaos from the Frosty Fight Club here.
I have some Holiday Announcements for you!

First off, we want to remind you that the submission period for the Frosty Community Mapmaker contest is is almost over.

You will NEED to join the Frosty Fight Club discord and post in the channel #sr-map-submission with the required info.
Join here: http://dsc.gg/frostyfightclub

Beginning December 1st, the SR Advisory Counsel (sans anyone who submitted a map) will be reviewing the entries and providing feedback.
We will provide ample opportunity to edit the map based on this feedback. After this, we will rereview the map and submit a final score.
The maps then will be shown off in the December SR Monthly for everyone to see and for us to get a "player's opinion score" and then for final scoring.
We will then submit the final maps to Gert for review and to see if anything would prevent any of the maps to make it into the curated workshop playlist.

We will declare the winners at the January SR Monthly event happening on the 25th (the fourth Saturday of the month).

Secondly, We'd like to announce the evolution of the Learner's League into what is being called [b]SR Elevation[/b], a more expanded and open format for players to self-organize for training, friendlies, and more.

Our Goal will be: [b]"To learn and grow as a community. To ELEVATE new and inexperienced players."[/b]

[b]Here is the blueprint for SR Elevation:[/b]

Multiple Events (Time Trial Tuesdays, 6 person Round Robin training sessions (mock tournaments), Coaching Checkpoints, and some surprises!)

To Qualify: Players must make a post in the channel #⁠sr-elevation in the thread(s) in the Frosty Fight Club established for this purpose.

There will be threads for players of the following hours/skill levels for sign up:
[list]
[*] 0-100 hours
[*] 101-250 hours
[*] 251-500 hours
[*] 500-750 hours
[*] 751-999 hours
[*] 1000+ hours or more
[/list]

These groups will be organized by one or more coaches or mentors.

If you are 1k hours and/or more and would like to help teach and play with newer players (becoming a mentor), please also post in the #⁠sr-elevation channel in the FFC discord.

The first SR Elevation event will be held next week (weekly to be known as Time Trial Tuesdays) in the form of a time trial event for each group.

Please join and post any questions or feedback for us. 🙂

Thank you all for the support and please take the time to watch out for the upcoming sale on the game itself to support this game moving forward and to get new players into the game. 

TheSilentChaos, Volunteer Community Manager and Organizer ❤️

notes.title: Mapmaker Contest
notes.content:
Hello Mapmakers.. Time for Frosty Mapmaker Contest 2

We will be accepting submission beginning November 1st until the 31st.

You must state the "theme of the map" and adhere and justify it if asked.

You must make a overview of the map and either a video or a detailed post explaining the map and it's design.

Judgement Criteria: 
[list]
[*] Map Design and Theme (checked against other officials and popular workshop maps)
[*] Overall Judge's Opinion
[*] Players' Voting
[/list]
You can get up to 100 points in each area and we will take the scores and add them up and average them. This is allow for some leeway for people to be creative.

The judges will be the SR Advisory Council. If a member of the council submits a map, they must abstain from voting. This is to curtail influence in judging/voting.

There will be judges of all skill levels and hours.

VOTING will be held in game and also ONLY in the Frosty Fight Club discord when the contest begins.
Voting will begin December and will last until the end of the year. The new year will feature our finalists and then the maps in question will be submitted for review by @Gert-Jan.

Just like last time... MORE THAN ONE map can win if the quality is there. It is at @Gert-Jan if they get added to the curated workshop.

notes.title: It's time for a BoostaCoke!
notes.content:
Surprise! We're back with another free update!

Today, we're introducing a whole new mechanic in the world of SpeedRunners, and we couldn't be more excited about it.
Up until now, there have always been two main mechanics in the game; items and boost. In this update, we're adding a third - [b]boostacokes[/b]!
This iconic drink, as promoted by Speedrunner himself in New Rush City's famous nightclub, is able to change the whole dynamic of a match.

[b]Here's how it works:[/b]
[list]
[*] pick up boostacokes to increase your maximum speed
[*] each boostacoke increases your speed by a few percent
[*] collect up to 10 boostacokes in total
[*] you drop a few boostacokes if you get hit by an explosionz
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4468079/9b7a7528938a51c8bcf42d2585c9ae78d9d3fc72.gif[/img]

And that's not all! To test this new feature, we added a [b]new official map[/b] with corresponding theme called '[i]Laboratory[/i]'.

Let us know in the comments below, on Discord or via Twitter what you think about the new map and mechanic. If you like how boostacokes change the dynamic of a match, we might add them into existing maps as well!

notes.title: Announcing the Team Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4468079/a0aa8398df922c2527b028431d7bae37653c6888.png[/img]

We all know that speedrunning is about two things; SPEED and RUNNING. But which of the two is more important? Is the competition all about getting the highest SPEED, or is it one’s skill in RUNNING that ultimately decides the winner of a race?

That’s a question that’s been creating quite a controversy in New Rush City, where two opposing factions have formed; TEAM SPEED and TEAM RUNNING. [i]“For sure it’s all about speed”[/i], says Buckshot, spokesmammal of team speed. [i]“I mean, you win races by being the speediest of runners - it’s called SPEEDrunners for a reason!”[/i] Gil wholeheartedly disagrees, saying [i]“you can’t get speedy without running first. It’s obviously pronounced speedRUNNERS!”[/i].

As the emotions are heating up between our speedy heroes, it’s become clear that each and every one of us must pick a side. So, which side are you on; team SPEED or team RUNNING? Decide quickly, because ON JULY 19th WE’LL BE RELEASING THE TEAM UPDATE!

This (free) update will add TEAMPLAY to speedrunner matches. You’ll be able to play 2v2, as well as 2v1 or 2v1v1. Pick a teammate and pick a team (team speed or team running) and work together to win races! Here’s what we’re planning:
[list]
[*]Teammates share their boost bars
[*]Teammates can swap their items
[*]Score 4 points as a team to win
[*][h1]Coming July 19th![/h1]
[/list]

Alongside this completely free update, we’ll be releasing a new character pack as optional DLC. This pack will add 4 new runners to the roster, which we will talk more about in the upcoming weeks.

notes.title: The ELO Winter Season is upon us!
notes.content:
Winter is coming, the jolliest ELO season of the year! The Elo Winter Season will start a bit early, [b]Monday December 18th 2017[/b] and will run throughout the entrie winter until [b]March 20th 2018[/b].

It has been more than half a year ago since we last did an ELO season, so here is  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/207140/announcements/detail/666938475206112736]a link to an announement to get you up to speed[/url].
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4468079/e74edb0ee7d6034a443a1cd45bab7402c73d9b22.png[/img]
By the end of the season everybody who participated will gain the Winter ELO Season badge of the league tier you ended up in by the end of the season.

All players that are in Diamond league by the end of the season will get the unique Snow trail which will be the only way to ever get this trail in your inventory.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4468079/bb07f01519e60eb1ba76ca3494ad014988543876.gif[/img]

Based on what we have learned during the ELO Beta Season we made some changes for the Winter ELO Season:

[h1]More points![/h1]
In the previous season certain close games could give as few as 1.5 points or something underwhelming like that. More points are given this season, but the league requirements also have gone up!

[h1]Inactivity penalties[/h1]
During last season the best tactic was pretty much to reach Diamond league and not play anymore after that. Furthermore if you had not played for a while the system would assume your skill level was still the same. If you don't play on average 1 game per day over a period of 14 days in the Winter Season you will start losing 100 points every day.

[h1]Individual initial rating[/h1]
The start of previous season was pretty rough for a lot of players because players of all skill levels started with the same ELO rating. For the Winter Season we use the ratings from the previous Beta season to offset the initial rating a bit. This way the matchmaking system can actually find matches of your skill from the very start.

We hope you will enjoy the season.

Happy Holidays,
DoubleDutch Games
ːSpeedRunnerːːUnicːːCosmoːːHotHeadː

P.S. There will be a small surprise in the game during holiday season starting from December 21th 2017! Make sure to speculate obsessively below ːHotHeadː!

notes.title: Announcing: ELO Beta Season
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4468079/42a11d9c797fb90b3c54afc7595aa8945beda035.png[/img]
For almost 3 years now we've been running the same old ranking system. The system has been great for us. It has given some memorable moments from when the first player hit Platinum League. Or when [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/207140/discussions/2/537405286645652060/]Metanet01 got into the unobtainable Diamond League[/url]. This remained a feat replicated by only 8 other players to this day. Other than that the system also served as a skill indication, providing much better skill-based Match Making.

While the system has been good to us, it also has multiple issues. It feels a bit grindy and it could be better at representing current player skill.

[h1]The new ranking system[/h1]
In order to solve the issues with the current system we've been testing a new ranking system for a while now in secret on the ranking server. This is an [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elo_rating_system]ELO based[/url] system. We are now almost ready to start a public test with the ELO system.

As it stands we're aiming to introduce the new system on [u][b]Thursday April 13th 2017[/b][/u]. It's not quite ready yet, so there is a slight chance we may not make that, but things are looking good right now. We're planning to run the new system for a month until May 14th. For the duration we are running the new system we will freeze your current score. After May 14th we will revert back to the current ranking system. At that point you can start playing in the current ranking system where you left off on April 13th.

[i]But that's not all we have planned![/i]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/207140/announcements/detail/666938475212680483]On Monday we will reveal more about why you might want to join the [b]ELO Beta Season[/b].[/url]

notes.title: SpeedRunners is Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/t3EuflN.gif[/img]

[h1]Check out this slick SpeedRunners Launch Trailer that Tom made[/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rWwUDenjkzs

SpeedRunners is now officially out of Early Access. After hundreds of updates, several community uprisings (remember the whole Lethal Spikes and SpeedBoosting threads?), we are officially out. That's it. Version 1.0. 

Here's what the final version of SpeedRunners has to offer:

[h1]Gif Editor & Exporter[/h1]

A new feature in the Replays system is the ability to crop & export GIFs directly from within SpeedRunners, check it out!

[h1]Trails Shop & Editor[/h1]

Yes, you can now create your own trails for SpeedRunners and have them be available in the Trails Shop. This is a curated shop (think just like Team Fortress 2) where users can submit their content to. 

[h1]Mac & Linux[/h1]

I am playing SpeedRunners on a Mac, you guys! This actually works. 

[h1]Single Player Campaign[/h1]

The brand new single player campaign takes you on a "Mario Kart Style" adventure, going through the multiplayer maps with specific story bits and challenges. The goal of the single player campaign is to ease players into the competitive online part of the game.

[h1]Twitch Betting[/h1]

You can now setup twitch betting when livestreaming SpeedRunners and it's tied to the tinyBuild rewards program. 

[h1]But wait, what does going out of Early Access mean?[/h1]

It means that the core features of the game are finished. We will still update the game, and are fully committed to working with the community. The only difference is that the core development team will switch their focus to consoles.

[h1]A huge THANK YOU to the community![/h1]

A special, enormous, hug-worthy THANK YOU to everyone who have been with us during Early Access. It's been an insane journey and without you guys we wouldn't be here. The hundred-reply threads on the forums, the in-depth discussions, the King of Speeds, everything about SpeedRunners Early Access revolved around obsessively reading the forum and figuring out the best solutions. 

Yes, everyone in Early Access is getting a special BETA trail which is available right now. 

This week we are having a launch event at PAX East in Boston with PurpleTurkey showing off his skills. Within the coming weeks we will reveal post-launch plans which include more tournaments and prizes. 

Huge hugs
- tinyBuild and DoubleDutch Teams

notes.title: The Noob's Guide To SpeedRunners
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/JsfMOaK.png[/img]

SpeedRunners is one of those games anyone can pick up at a convention or party. Every now and then though there's this one guy at these events that starts to kick everyone's butt. It's probably because he knows the basic strats of the game. Good thing I'm here to share these with you. 

If you're a novice player, or someone considering buying SpeedRunners (it's in Early Access until April 19th!), you might find these tips useful. 

Let's start with the basics and work our way up. Before I get to items, I assume you understand how SpeedRunners work -- 4 players spawn in a map, and the camera follows the players in front. If you fall off-screen, you lose. "Press a to jump and figure it out" is usually good enough of an explanation. 

One important thing to understand is momentum and how to get it. A very simple example is the gif below.

[h1]Getting Momentum With Slopes[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/sHERoDD.gif[/img]

[list][*]Both players jump down
[*]Both players hit a diagonal slope
[*]The slope transfers their downwards momentum into sideways momentum. That's why they have that fancy trail.[/list]

[h1]Let's Talk About Items![/h1]

Items are what makes SpeedRunners the friendship-destroying game many people love. I'm going to use GIFs to illustrate proper use of items. Note that these are basic tactics just to help new players understand what's happening. 

[h1]The Crate[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ms9l7Bs.gif[/img]

The crate might seem like a useless object as it's easy to jump over, but pro level SpeedRunners players had decisive matches because of it. 

[list][*]Use it to dodge golden hooks
[*]Place it in spots where players have to slide, that'll slow the others down or force them to burn items
[*]Place them where upwards ladders end - that forces players to awkwardly jump over, costing valuable momentum[/list]

[h1]The Golden Hook[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/5fTOwSf.gif[/img]

The Golden Hook is probably the most iconic and friendship ruining weapon. There's more to it though as we've seen from high level play. 

[list][*]It's easy to dodge over long distances by sliding
[*]Most efficient against other noobs or close-range against experienced players
[*]Having it in your inventory limits experienced opponents' actions[/list]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/67Wsj6i.gif[/img]

Let me talk about that last point for a second. When you have the Golden Hook you're playing a mind game with the people in front of you. Most people will anxiously slide all over the place, anticipating the hook -- while others will keep onto items like the Crate in order to dodge. The best players in the world use the hook to break opponents' super-speed which is also very effective. 

Remember that you also take your opponents' momentum when grappling them. 

[h1]The Rocket[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/VW6yPXa.gif[/img]

The Rocket is a slow but effective weapon. It will slowly lock onto a target and follow it... if there's open space. Otherwise it can be used efficiently in tunnels when you need to stun the 3 players in front of you. 

[list][*]Effective in close-quarter situations
[*]Slow in open spaces
[*]Great stun if it hits[/list]

[h1]The Freezeray[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/9lRtLNq.gif[/img]

The Freezeray was added as a more direct item that can freeze multiple enemies. The core feature is that it goes through walls and can be used with great efficiency during varying vertical paths. 

[list][*]Has a build-up
[*]Fires through walls
[*]Freezes your enemies for a couple of seconds[/list]

If your enemies had momentum, that momentum will transfer to their frozen state -- it's not always good to freeze someone going a downhill slope very fast.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/RIW3DR9.gif[/img]

In the gif above, you see that the momentum of SpeedRunners with no friction transfered to the downhill slope -- and the freezeray wasn't as effective

[h1]The Shockwave[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/a6sb5Zy.gif[/img]

The beautiful shockwave is an effective area weapon. In the most recent iteration, ti fires in front of the casting player. It will blow up all over items and push players away from its central direction. It means it's also great for boosting yourself forward.

[list][*]Area weapon that counters everything in the game
[*]Great for offense and defense
[*]When used skillfully, creates magnificent moments of all players slowing down[/list]

[h1]The Fireball[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/aISBhd6.gif[/img]

A very fast weapon that just keeps on rolling forward. The Fireball is players' favorite item to clear a path (including through other players). It can be fired backwards to knock down players mid-air, and has the same stun effect as The Rocket. 

[list][*]Fast forward-rolling weapon
[*]Great for clearing paths, like getting rid of crates
[*]Efficient for both offense and defense if used properly[/list]

[h1]Learning To Counter[/h1]

The fun of SpeedRunners comes when all items come together and result in situations like this:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/KuDcIOK.gif[/img]

[h1]Those are the basics![/h1]

I hope this helps people get a head start in SpeedRunners and eventually get a s good as these guys from the recent King of Speed finals:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=425xdDwOlQc

Community! What do you guys think? Am I missing any vital beginners tips?

notes.title: Release Date announced! April 19th
notes.content:
[h1]SpeedRunners is sprinting out of Early Access on April 19th![/h1]

We're proud to announce today that SpeedRunners will see its [b]full release on April 19th[/b], only two weeks from now!

[img]http://tinybuild.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/blog-header.png[/img]

It's been a long and incredible journey since we released the first beta build back in 2013. Now, over 50 updates and 2 years later, we're finally at a point where we can confidently call the game finished. 

When the game first entered Early Access, we had no idea how much the game would take off - or that we would be working on it for such a long time. It was a humble prototype back then - fun and playable, but filled with game-breaking crashes and many exploitable bugs. With hard work, dedication and a lot of helpful feedback, it slowly expanded it into a highly competitive game (an official eSport even!) that sold over a million units. The process has been amazing, thanks to you; the wonderful community we've come across here on the Steam forum <3 <3 <3

Now, the full release won't be just another small update. We've got a couple cool new features lined up for you.

[h1]Mac & Linux[/h1]
Along with the full release, the game will also be available on Mac and Linux. It's all the same codebase, which means there's full cross-platform support. So Mac and Linux players can play with each other, as well as with PC players. We've been running a beta for this the past few weeks, and it looks like the game runs smoothly on these platforms, so yay, finally! Full Mac and Linux support!

[h1]Custom Trails[/h1]
This is a big feature, that we've been working on in secret for quite some time. In the full release, you'll be able to design, upload, share and even sell your own custom speed trails! Here's an example of one that I made:

[img]http://tinybuild.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/ezgif-1561847279.gif[/img]

Ever since we introduced the first trails on handicapped characters and as a reward for winning the ESL tournament, people have been super excited about getting their own trails. Some even went as far as hacking the game to get their own custom trails in. Well, this is no longer necessary, as we've built an full-fledged trail editor just for you! This editor allows you to create the most outrageous, fun, fancy and sweet-looking trails you can imagine. You can create layers, use your own artwork and even add particle effects! Here's another that I made, just for fun:

[img]http://tinybuild.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/ezgif-3926854876.gif[/img]

Once you're happy with the trail you've created, you can submit it to the community for curation. If it's accepted, other players will be able to buy it from the steam store, and you'll get a portion of the revenue!

[h1]Singleplayer campaign[/h1]
We've created a new campaign mode, which dives into the backstory of some of the beloved SpeedRunners characters. It's a Mario Kart-style campaign, in which you play against bots of various difficulty levels in a tournament setting. notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/PPnZQtV.jpg[/img]

Another week, another SpeedRunners pro interview. Last time we talked to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/207140/announcements/detail/991156269321824822]Decard Cain[/url] -- this week it's all about DistinctMadness, a SpeedRunners player who has seen plenty of ESL action over the months.

Let's do it, DistinctMadness-flavored.

[h1]SpeedRunners Meet The Pros - DistinctMadness[/h1]

[url=https://m.youtube.com/channel/UCPkBQbsvJw-K4iKZ52GSs5w]DistinctMadness' YouTube channel[/url]

Quick-facts:
[list][*][b]Real name[/b]: Jacob
[*][b]Age[/b]: 16
[*][b]From[/b]: America
[*][b]League[/b]: Platinum League
[*][b]Favourite SpeedRunners character[/b]: Moonraker
[*][b]Favourite map[/b]: Night Club
[*][b]Favourite item[/b]: The Pulse/Shockwave[/list]

[list][*][b]How did you get into SpeedRunners?[/b][/list]
I saw some videos on YouTube and was like, "Hey that's cool."

Didn't buy it for a while though, due to lack of funds. After Christmas that year, without informing those who would be paying, I bought the game and have been hooked ever since.

[list][*][b]How long have you been playing the game?[/b][/list]
Since December 30th, 2013

[list][*][b]Are there any other SpeedRunners players who you class as your rivals?[/b][/list]
As of now it'd be hard to say who is a rival, but the name that comes to mind is Unreal.

[list][*][b]How would you class your playing style?[/b][/list]
Either stay just barely in the lead until you can win, or chill in the back and let the other players knock each other out

[list][*][b]How do you prepare for SpeedRunners tournaments?[/b][/list]
I start warming up at least an hour early, while wearing a hoodie with the hood up. I also play specific maps that I believe will be picked more than others. Its all about the predictions.

[list][*][b]What's your advice for other players looking to go pro at SpeedRunners?[/b][/list]
Whenever you run into somebody who is beating you in a game, instead of leaving because you can't win, keep playing until you start beating that player, no matter how long it takes. If you have to leave, try to add the person to play with later. Rage quitting gets you nowhere.

notes.title: Update r48 - bugfixes!
notes.content:
We've focused our attention these last two weeks on fixin' bugs and polishing the game. 

The result is r48, available now, which fixes a lot of minor issues that have been lingering for too long. For instance, [b]respawning[/b] is a lot better now; there should be no more mid-air or on-slope respawns that lead to cheap kills. The fireball code has also been re-written, which should make it behave a lot more consistent.

We've also taken a look at [b]performance[/b]. If you were having issues with the framerate before, it should hopefully run a bit smoother. You can now also set the graphics quality to 'low' in the options menu. This should have a noticable effect in "problem maps" Metro, Library, Warehouse, Factory and Plaza, as well as when rendering boost trails. Please let us know if this setting increases your framerate!

Finally, we've made another attempt at fixing the [b]mid-game join lag[/b]. Let us know if it still happens after this update! It's very difficult for us to reproduce it, so any help in testing is appreciated.

That's it for now! We hope you'll enjoy these updates and feel free to read the full changelog here: 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/207140/discussions/2/598199244892373717/

Happy running!
-Casper

notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/sd1H8X2.png[/img]

Hi everyone! Our own resident ex-journalist [url=https://twitter.com/RaveofRavendale]Mike Rose[/url] had an itch to chat with a bunch of you beautiful pro-SpeedRunners. The chats became so interesting that we decided to make a series of articles -- "SpeedRunners Meet The Pros". 

Who better to start off with other than the King Himself? 

[h1]SpeedRunners Meet The Pros - PurpleTurkey[/h1]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCBj8HWOp66WXzZtTJC0abQg]PurpleTurkey's YouTube channel[/url]

Quick-facts:
[list][*][b]Real name[/b]: Jacob
[*][b]Age[/b]: 18
[*][b]From[/b]: Canada
[*][b]League[/b]: Platinum League
[*][b]Favourite SpeedRunners character[/b]: Purple Unic
[*][b]Favourite map[/b]: Library
[*][b]Favourite item[/b]: The Bomb[/list]

[list][*][b]How did you get into SpeedRunners?[/b][/list]
The game first caught my eye near the beginning of its release. It seemed like something right up my alley, but I didn't end up buying it (big mistake). A couple months passed and I stumbled upon the game again on Steam. I had completely forgotten about it, so I mentioned it to a couple of friends and we all ended up buying it.

I remember the first time my friends and I played SpeedRunners laughing hysterically, screaming into our mics. After a week or so my friends started to play less, but not me. I couldn't stop playing. I just wanted to get faster, so I went to ranked.

[list][*][b]How long have you been playing the game?[/b][/list]
I've been playing since Aug 10th 2014

[list][*][b]Are there any other SpeedRunners players who you class as your rivals?[/b][/list]
Not as of right now, I have beaten all of my rivals at the King of Speed event

[list][*][b]How would you class your playing style?[/b][/list]
My play style is being able to adapt to any situation

[list][*][b]How do you prepare for SpeedRunners tournaments?[/b][/list]
I begin warming up an hour before go time and be sure to have hand warmers ready

[list][*][b]What's your advice for other players looking to go pro at SpeedRunners?[/b][/list]
Explore the game for its secrets, and don't be predictable

notes.title: ESL's #Go4SpeedRunners - 1,250 Eur in prizes!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/PsuCfSY.jpg[/img]

YOU GUYS, this is finally happening! Together with ESL, we are officially kicking off the Go4 SpeedRunners Europe series with some serious cash prizes involved! 

Until end of year there will be 7 cups, including 3 kick-off cups and 4 Go4 series cups. 

[h1]Official links:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Official [url=http://play.eslgaming.com/speedrunners/europe/news/261030/]ESL announcement & sign-up links[/url]
[*]Official ESL SpeedRunners [url=https://twitter.com/ESLSpeedRunners/status/664455104070742016]Twitter[/url]
[*]Official ESL SpeedRunners [url=https://www.facebook.com/ESLSpeedRunners/posts/78964930782968]Facebook[/url][/list]

[h1]Upcoming Kick-Off Cups:[/h1]

On every Sunday at 17:00 CET in November we will host one Kick Off Cup for all European players. The goal of the Kick Off Cups is to finalize the rule book together with you, the community. We want to start the Go4 Series in December with the best possible rule set we can have. To make the competition even more attractive the winner of each tournament will get an in-game trail similar to this one:

[img]http://gfx.esl.eu/gfx/media/play/speedrunners/europe/speedrunners-kick-off-prize.png[/img]

[*]Nov 15th - 17:00 CET	
1on1 Kick Off Cup #1 Europe - [url=http://play.eslgaming.com/speedrunners/europe/speedrunners/open/1on1-kick-off-cup-1-europe/]Sign Up[/url]

[*]Nov 22nd - 17:00 CET
1on1 Kick Off Cup #2 Europe - [url=http://play.eslgaming.com/speedrunners/europe/speedrunners/open/1on1-kick-off-cup-2-europe/]Sign Up[/url]

[*]Nov 29th - 17:00 CET
1on1 Kick Off Cup #3 Europe - [url=http://play.eslgaming.com/speedrunners/europe/speedrunners/open/1on1-kick-off-cup-3-europe/]Sign Up[/url]
[/list]

[h1]Upcoming Go4 Cups:[/h1]

The Go4SpeedRunners Series is free for everyone and all players can sign up for it. Each week we will have one tournament, where you can earn points to qualify for the Monthly Final. On every Sunday players, who win at least one match, will receive points and the winner will receive an additional [b]50 EUR prize money. [/b]

The Monthly Final will take place at the beginning of each month. The final will consist of eight players who gathered the most points during the weekly cups. They will compete for a total prize money of [b]200 EUR[/b], which is split between the first and second place.

On top of the cash prizes, we will send these 4 Golden Falcons (they're not real gold) to the winners of each Go4 Series tournament in December. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/rjVNfb5.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Dec 6th - 17:00 CET	
Go4SpeedRunners Cup #1 Europe - 	[url=http://play.eslgaming.com/speedrunners/europe/speedrunners/major/go4speedrunners-europe/cup-1/]Sign Up[/url]

[*]Dec 13th - 17:00 CET	
Go4SpeedRunners Cup #2 Europe - [url=http://play.eslgaming.com/speedrunners/europe/speedrunners/major/go4speedrunners-europe/cup-2/]Sign Up[/url]

[*]Dec 20th - 17:00 CET	
Go4SpeedRunners Cup #3 Europe - [url=http://play.eslgaming.com/speedrunners/europe/speedrunners/major/go4speedrunners-europe/cup-3/]Sign Up[/url]

[*]Dec 27th - 17:00 CET	
Go4SpeedRunners Cup #4 Europe - [url=http://play.eslgaming.com/speedrunners/europe/speedrunners/major/go4speedrunners-europe/cup-4/]Sign Up[/url]

[h1]Why Europe?[/h1]

Fear not, if this series takes off (which you can help us with by SIGNING UP!), we will expand into more territories. It's just much easier to manage for the studio being in Europe, and the ESL Summer Series was a good test to see how we ca pull it off. 

Again, don't miss the official announcement on ESL - http://play.eslgaming.com/speedrunners/europe/news/261030/

notes.title: r43: Main Menu Overhaul, New Music, Practice Mode [live]
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/9QwWZLA.png[/img]

Hi everyone! 

We've got another update for you today, and it's a big one! r43 adds two new music tracks, a solo-run practice mode and has the main menu focusing on some cool community stuff! There's also a ton of gameplay, XP and editor improvements, so check out the full list below!

Release log for r43:

[h1]Overhauled the Main Menu with a focus on the Community:[/h1]
* There's a dedicated 'Updates' box, with important information
* Added a 'featured content' box, where we highlight cool stuff, like youtube videos
* Added a dedicated box to the King of Speed tournament
* Animated the background a bit
* Level Select: the workshop list will show the level your opponent voted on, making it easier for you to vote on the same map, even if you are not subscribed to it

[h1]New Music![/h1]
* Added 2 new music tracks, played randomly
* They're 'work in progress', and will get a quality-upgrade later

[h1]Added a Practice Menu:[/h1]
* Has an option to quickly set up match against bots
* Or, allows you to run any map all by yourself

[h1]Gameplay:[/h1]
* Tweaked the camera movement, focusing more on the player in the lead
* New artwork for the Shockwave, also changed the functionality a bit
* The Shockwave should work a lot better and more consistent now
* Doing quick turns with the grappling hook is a bit more forgiving with regards to which buttons you press
* The golden hook-grab should feel a tiny bit more elastic now
* Added a little swing ceiling in Prototype2
* Improved some graphical feedback on gameplay events, like when you hook misses or is blocked
* If you shoot a golden hook into a box, the box will be destroyed
* Fixed a minor checkpoint issue in Casino
* Made lethal spikes/lasers look different from non-lethal ones
* Fireballs explode when they hit eachother
* Reduced Handicapped-frozen time from 1.5 to 1.0 seconds
* Superboost now also works when Frozen
* You can now only trigger Triggers (with a bomb or fireball) that have Switches connected to them
* Made Sherlock Bones and Doctor Smart fit the collision shape better.

[h1]Improved feedback in the XP System:[/h1]
* The post-game screen is a lot quicker now,
* and better communicates how many points you scored and for what
* Added some in-game popups that tell you when you did a cool thing, like a Triple Freeze

[h1]Editor:[/h1]
* Massive framerate improvements
* Improved the camera movement
* Press "I" to give yourself an item, during playtest
* Shows the HUD during playtest
* Disallowed moving box-selected Actors out of the levelBounds

[h1]Bugs:[/h1]
* Fixed a bug that caused the game not to start up sometimes
* Fixed a bug where sometimes you would teleport upon landing
* Fixed a desync issue causing the sudden death explosions to appear at the start of a round
* Fixed some crashes and bugs in the editor, specifcally when switching themes
* Fixed a bug which caused the item-box in the HUD to be stuck in its animation sometimes
* Fixed a bug where your vote for a workshop map sometimes didnt register
* Restored functionality where a newly subscribed level automatically shows up in the level list
* The "Recently played with" steam list is now also filled if you are not a lobby host
* The sudden death start stinger is now treated as music in terms volume.

notes.title: r41: AFK kick, new level, replay system
notes.content:
The latest update to SpeedRunners adds a ton of new features. The main one being auto-kicking AFK players. We still need to tweak this and are looking for your feedback! 

Change log:

- Level: Prototype 1 got a big makeover
- Level: Added Prototype 2
- Level: Tweaks in Themepark, Powerplant and Factory
- Feature: Inactive players are now auto kicked after 15 seconds
- Tweak: Increased the fireball lifetime from 6 seconds to 20 seconds
- Tweak: Stun behavior has been made more consistent
- Tweak: Bombs are back in ranked but they do not stun anymore
- Feature: The ranking friend leaderboard now shows ranking points
- Feature: Added an experimental replay feature. Some notes:

By default replay recording is turned on now, this way we can find possible issues with it. You can turn it off in the options menu.
-- Right now you can record only one game but with some file fiddling you may be able to store them for longer.
-- If the gameplay or levels are updated your replay may stop working well, so do not consider it some sort of 'backup' of a game.

Let us know what you think!

notes.title: r40: XP System, New Characters, Price Increase
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Z91OVYK.png[/img]

[h1]Biggest SpeedRunners Update To Date[/h1]

Today we released r40, the biggest SpeedRunners content update to date. The discussion about this update has been going on for months on the forums. We felt like SpeedRunners was missing long-term goals, and was getting overwhelming with the amount of content. 

[h1]Ranked is now locked for new players[/h1]

We also didn't want players to join ranked without understand the game's mechanics in-depth, and learning the maps. 

Add the increasing amount of designed characters, and we had a problem. The solution was to create an XP System. Now new players will start off with most of the content locked, including weapons, characters, and maps. Ranked will also be locked until Level 5. 

[h1]You level up and unlock content gradually[/h1]

As you level up, you will unlock all this content, and more. The idea is to have a full story unfold as you level up, told through comic books. These will come in later. 

Today's update is a first pass on the XP System, so things may get tweaked. Existing players who want to try to level up from Level 0 now can erase their progress in the options menu. Don't worry though, there's plenty of new stuff added to the game. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/rSk0UMW.png[/img]

[h1]Not the full update log[/h1]

[list][*]New loading screen lines
[*]Added Romanian translation
[*]Bug fixes
[*]Added like 50 new characters if you count alternate colors
[*]Added an XP system
[*]There's more stuff for you to discover yourself
[/list]

[h1]Price Increase Coming June 1st[/h1]

In line with this huge content update, we will also be increasing the price of SpeedRunners to $14.99 on June 1st. 

[h1]XP Progression Needs Your Feedback![/h1]

Please give us feedback on the progression of unlocks. These are things we need to tweak as we go.

notes.title: Fan Trailer Contest Winner is....
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/tmXsOkJ.png[/img]

We've had several dozen entries in the SpeedRunners Fan Trailer Contest, which I'm very happy with. People spent loads of time recording and editing gameplay, and compiling that into an exciting trailer.

[h1]SpeedRunners trailers are difficult![/h1]

SpeedRunners is one of those games that's rather difficult to sell just in a trailer. It's very easy to sell based on people's reactions playing the game - Let's Players do a great job at that. It's also easy to sell people on the game at shows and lan parties. But a trailer is difficult. On one hand you need to show loads of enticing gameplay, on the other - the editing needs to be exciting, and you need to explain what is going on.

I bet everyone who participated realized these challenges halfway through the editing process :) Welcome to my world!

There was loads of debate on which trailer is the best. Amongst the several great entries, one trailer took me by surprise. As a marketing guy, most of the time I'll take the easy way out - outline a list of features, especially in a game like SpeedRunners where it's difficult to tell what's going on. Ultimately, what you need to do is try to explain the "feeling" of a game. Great trailers do this self-explanatorily, and we have one here.

[h1]The winner is....[/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fd-xIrTW708

[h1]Congratulations to BorderTheA[/h1]

BorderTheA managed to create a trailer that has no text, yet captures the core essence of SpeedRunners. How the game has you almost break your controller in a tough match. What it's like to successfully land a match-defying overtake. I suggest you check the trailer out!

Notable mentions are with...

[h1]Taters for making an exciting gameplay montage with an interesting choice for music[/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SchxyYKCKS0

[h1]A short, sweet, descriptive trailer by Syntax[/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=02S_hhLCevw

Check out all of the entries in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/207140/discussions/2/618458030669466141/#p1]official thread[/url]

Let us know what you think in the comments below!

notes.title: SpeedRunners Gets New Pixel Art Style
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/hObw553.png[/img]

After months of research and numerous heated debates amongst the SpeedRunners team, the biggest update in the game’s history goes live today, altering the visual design to give the experience a more pixel-art feel.

[h1]Check the new art work in action![/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v3gC2Gq3TSI 

More and more indie titles these days are going down the pixel-art route. It’s widely believed that this is down to the reduced costs of producing pixel-art — but new research discovered by tinyBuild suggests that the average consumer is more likely to purchase a game if it is presented in this style.

Working with experts at the University of Oxford*, tinyBuild has determined that pixel-art games sell roughly 15 times better than other art styles. New ground-breaking statistics show that the perceived size of the pixels in a game directly correlates with the amount of enjoyment a player receives.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Qa6Qo2F.jpg[/img]

With this in mind, we have been painstakingly working day and night to provide the players, and our fans, with the visual style they never realized they wanted. SpeedRunners has been completely revamped to satisfy the pixel-art movement, and the pixel-art update is now live for all players.

Note that there is no way to revert back to the original art style — we’ve thrown all that gloss and finish into a bin marked “stupid” and it’s never coming back. We’re now in the process of pixelating all of our other games too, and any third-party partners who resist will be immediately dropped.

Gert-Jan Stolk, SpeedRunners designer extraordinaire and the main driving force behind this move, explains, “SpeedRunners was getting too mainstream. Now it feels like an actual indie game I could sit down and play at Starbucks.”

We cannot wait to see your positive reactions to our new direction for SpeedRunners, and tinyBuild as a whole.

We’ve also determined, again thanks to research from the University of Oxford**, that all players prefer free-to-play games over paid games, so we’re currently in the process of injecting as many in-app purchases into our games as possible. You can expect to see those popping up (literally!) very soon.

==================================

New music by TeknoAXE

Important - we are aware of that on some newer machines retro text rendering is causing issues and are working on fixing this

notes.title: r38: Casino, new lobbies, random behavior, workshop
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/cZiEKyk.png[/img]

Hi everyone! Today's update is a big one. Finally the Casino map (previously known as Fresh Out - winner of our map making competition) got it's final artwork and theme, and we have a ton of other updates that Gert-Jan and Wouter have been working on. 

Custom game lobbies should now be much more intuitive when setting up custom matches, and map makers will be please with loads of additions to the Workshop. Tom spent some time implementing the graphics himself into Casino, and as a first time user of the Workshop got tons of feedback that got reimplemented back into the game. 

Full release log:

[list]
[b]r38 - Casino map, Reworked custom lobby UI (February 13th, 2015)[/b]
[*]Added new map: Casino! It's the winning map from the first workshop competition: "Fresh Out" by GraphiqueNez2.
[*]The custom game lobby is completely re-implemented. We hope it works a bit more intuitive now.
[*]The random official map button now actually means random instead of "I don't care what map we play". This makes the level selection less biased toward workshop maps.
[*]The map selection should feel more random now. If possible the same maps is never played twice in a row anymore.
[*]Added some flashing and beeping on the last 5 seconds of the lobby and level selection countdown timer.
[*]Improved the level editor's graphics editor:
[*] - You can only edit graphics on the selected layer (press [ and ] to select different layers).
[*] - Graphics within the same layer can now be ordered. (press Home or End to send a graphic all the way to the front or back, press PageUp or PageDown to bring a graphic one step to the front or back)
[*] - The hitbox of graphics on parallax layers is now actually where the graphic is.
[*]The in-game player info screen now has mouse support.
[*]Freeze rays are now canceled at the end of a round.
[*]Fixed the bug where the game would not end if all players would fall off the bottom of the screen at the same time.
[*]Fixed a bug where explosions near a stunned player would have delayed effect.
[*]В игре совершенно нету новых секретных персонажей
[*]Moved the steam notifications to a more convenient location during lobby and level select.
[*]/goat is no longer how you get the goat.
[/list]

[*]4 bots spawn, start playing the game

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/338680/]Download the Party Mode on Steam[/url] (on Steam, works only if you don't have the full game - click Download Demo)

[url=http://speedrunners.com]Download a Standalone Party Mode - works outside of Steam[/url]

*note - you can't install the demo on accounts with the full game, it's a Steam restriction - we're working on getting a similar Party Mode into the full game. 

[h1]We really need the community's help to spread this demo, as we feel it's a great party game - that's free! Ideal for college campuses, bars, and any local multiplayer party![/h1]

notes.title: King of Speed 2 and fighting cancer
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/AKkik6c.png[/img]

Join #TeamFalcon or #TeamSpeedRunner next week in King of Speed 2 - the boostanoid-fueled official SpeedRunners tournament. 

[h1]Fight cancer, with speed and running![/h1]

Next week we are introducing 2 DLC character packs into SpeedRunners. These packs contain 4 celebrity characters each. One pack is assigned to [b]#TeamFalcon[/b], the other - to [b]#TeamSpeedRunner[/b]. 

If you play as The Falcon, or any of the characters on [b]#TeamFalcon[/b], wins count towards that team. Same for [b]#TeamSpeedRunner[/b]. You don't need to buy the DLC to participate, but if you do - it will be for a good cause. 

[h1]# Play as your favorite Youtuber or one of the team leads (SpeedRunner or Falcon)
# Your wins add to your team's total score
# Team with most wins by November 20th is the winner
# We will donate money made from the winning DLC to cancer research[/h1]

You can guess the team assignments yourself :) 

[h1]Participants:[/h1]
[list]
[*]PewDiePie
[*]Markiplier 
[*]JesseCox
[*]CinnamonToastKen
[*]Strippin
[*]Dodger
[*]PeanutButterGamer
[*]UberHaxorNova[/list]

[h1]Prepare for the ultimate showdown between The Falcon and SpeedRunner. 

20/10/2014[/h1]

FAQ

[h1]What is King of Speed?[/h1]

King of Speed is an in-game tournament between the characters of SpeedRunners. The first one was held in December 2013 and featured an ARG, the culmination of which revealed Game Modifiers. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/xBk2JOS.jpg[/img]

In the first King of Speed, we counted wins of individual characters for a month, and in the end Cosmo was crowned as King Cosmo and wore a crown for a month in-game. 

This time The Falcon faces off with SpeedRunner in an ultimate showdown of Speed and Running. And they are backed up by teams of Youtubers to help!

[h1]Do I need to buy the DLC to participate?[/h1]

No, you can support your team by playing as either The Falcon or SpeedRunner

[h1]But SpeedRunner has 4 versions of the skin, but Falcon has only 1?[/h1]

We are adding 3 more skins to the Falcon just for this event. Spoilers? I probably shouldn't be revealing this. 

[h1]Which charity are you donating money to?[/h1]

This is something we're figuring out with the help of experienced parties like Humble Bundle. If you have suggestions - let us know. 

[h1]What's the DLC price?[/h1]

We are aiming for $2.99 per pack, so less than $1 per character

[h1]Why cancer research?[/h1]

Personal statement from Alex Nichiporchik (CEO @tinyBuild):

Screw cancer. It took the life of countless people in my family, and almost took mine. I believe with the popularity of SpeedRunners we can make a difference to advance its research.

In the first King of Speed, we counted wins of individual characters for a month, and in the end Cosmo was crowned as King Cosmo and wore a crown for a month in-game. 

This time The Falcon faces off with SpeedRunner in an ultimate showdown of Speed and Running. And they are backed up by teams of Youtubers to help!

No, you can support your team by playing as either The Falcon or SpeedRunner

[h1]But SpeedRunner has 4 versions of the skin, but Falcon has only 1?[/h1]

We are adding 3 more skins to the Falcon just for this event. Spoilers? I probably shouldn't be revealing this. 

[h1]Which charity are you donating money to?[/h1]

This is something we're figuring out with the help of experienced parties like Humble Bundle. If you have suggestions - let us know. 

[h1]What's the DLC price?[/h1]

We are aiming for $2.99 per pack, so less than $1 per character

Personal statement from Alex Nichiporchik (CEO @tinyBuild):

Screw cancer. It took the life of countless people in my family, and almost took mine. I believe with the popularity of SpeedRunners we can make a difference to advance its research.

notes.title: Updates, r31, EGX, TGS, New People, Youtubers
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

I wanted to take a moment and talk about the current state of SpeedRunners and where it's going in the coming months. 

[h1]Most important thing - upcoming level changes to classic levels![/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TyJv0LyxvWo&list=UUHLuN_JL66bD8fdJWmQ-gNw

Casper walks us through some important changes in SS Royale, Library, and Factory. 

[h1]Tokyo Game Show[/h1]

Casper just took off to Tokyo to showoff SpeedRunners as part of Sense of Wondernight. I hear he has some T-Shirts with him :) 

[h1]EGX Rezzed[/h1]

Part of the team is going to London next week to showcase SpeedRunners at EGX Rezzed. We will continue doing the tinyQuest there, so make sure to collect ALL THE CARDS! 

[h1]October Lets Player Update Inbound[/h1]

The artistic part of the team is now working on a Lets Player character pack. During PAX Prime we teamed up with Polaris to get Youtube celebrities to play SpeedRunners together, and we are getting them into the game as characters. The idea is that we want to raise money for cancer research, in light of my cancer fight 10 years ago, and TotalBiscuit's recent encounter. [b]Screw cancer![/b] 

[h1]r31 still in testing[/h1]

We're still holding off releasing r31. The [url=http://www.gfinity.net/pewdiepie/ladders/speedrunners]$6.5k Gfinity Cup[/url] is still on-going and it feels very bad to accidentally break the game during arguably our kickstart into the E-Sports scene. 

[h1]New developer on the DoubleDutch team![/h1]

The DoubleDutch Team has a new full-time developer on board! Wouter is now working on something Casper came up with during Gamescom - flipped gravity volumes. So you can drop a volume in the level editor that flips the gravity. 

This bring the total team to 6 people. 

Casper - game & level design
Gert-Jan - everything code, network & magic related
Wouter - more code
Alex (me) - production/marketing
Tom - character design, animation
Matthijs - 3D animation (newest characters are animated in 3D and exported to 2D sprites)

We're also working on a deal with an external 2D animation studio to speed up the process with new characters. Right now the plan is for the Lets Player Youtube Pack to be a separate thing you buy and we donate the proceeds from that to charity. In regards to actual in-game characters - we are still debating how that gets into the game. 

*backflips out of announcement*

notes.title: Update r31! [rolled back]
notes.content:
We're all going to go to PAX PRIME in Seattle this weekend, where we'll have a [b]HUGE[/b] booth where people can play SpeedRunners and where a very special and awesome thing is going to take place that we can't talk about yet, but definitely is going to be [b]AWESOME![/b]

Anyway, it's been a while since we did our last major update. Since then, we've released a lot of small updates, that we didn't feel were enough by themselves to mark it as a "new" update. For instance, we've changed the behaviour when landing on slopes a little bit. You now keep your momentum, resulting in high velocities if you do it right. Even though that's quite a game-changer, it was so small of a change that it was still considered as part of r30.

Seeing as we're leaving now for a week though, we thought it would be a good idea to try to make sure we did push an update for you all before we left. So, without further ado, here's [b]UPDATE R31![/b]

This update adds the first iteration of artwork for the ZOO level (formerly Prototype). We're going to animate some stuff later on, but this should already give you a good idea of what we're aiming for with this level. We've also updated some animations on Buckshot, Gil and 招き猫, most notably the latter's jump animation. We've also updated the Level Editor to be a bit more user-friendly and by popular request we've added a 'no items' option in custom games, amonst many other small things. 

The full list of changes can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/207140/discussions/2/864975026748887209/] here[/url].

Enjoy!

Oh, and don't forget - if you're attending PAX, make sure to drop by our Booth (#6003 on the 6th floor, near the PAX10), especially on Saturday the 30th!

notes.title: r25: Massive Map Update, Spikes are Non-Lethal
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/pVSkgFj.png[/img]

A massive update went live today. It includes visuals and layout changes for 4 maps, and a game-changing update to spikes - they are no longer lethal. We spent some time playing user-generated levels and watching lets play videos, and realized just how brutal spikes can be on new players. There's no way to know they're coming if you're in front. 

Here are the changes:

[h1]Spikes[/h1]
[list][*] no longer kill you
[*] you bounce forward and get stunned for a second
[*] no longer running in front gets you blindly killed[/list]

If you were running in the front and hit a spike, odds are you will lose your lead. If you're running behind and hit a spike, you have a slim chance to recover. It feels much more satisfying (and controller-gripping) to have a chance to recover. What do you guys think?

[h1]Map updates![/h1]

[h1]Theme Park[/h1]
[list][*] Redesigned the full right section (not many people were taking the far-right route)
[*] Added a cannon-boost pad before the big jump and the carousel swing, it shoots you up
[*] Added an upwards facing boost tunnel at the end of big jump, so people don't fall down
[*] Redesigned section after the big jump
[/list]

[h1]Factory[/h1]
[list][*] Tweaked bottom dual-tunnel section
[*] Removed the big wall of death at right section, replaced with a more forgiving boost-tunnel that shoots you up
[/list]

[h1]Night Club[/h1] (previous prototype level)
[list][*] Now looks like a nightclub! Complete with a DJ and VIP lounge. Can you get into the VIP lounge?!
[*] Bottom left section changed to include a boost-tunnel that opens if someone triggers a lever
[/list]

[h1]Silo[/h1] (previous prototype level)
[list][*] Now looks like a Silo! What do you think of the visuals?
[*] Removed triggerable saws
[/list]

[h1]Powerplant[/h1]
[list][*] Changed the right part of the map
[*] Changed the missile for a boost-tunnel
[*] Made the part after windmills more fluid
[/list]

[h1]Bonus Video[/h1]

Playtesting the updates, featuring Casper, Gert-Jan, Tom, Alex, and Matthijs as the camerman. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YrI_QNip4L8

[h1]What do you guys think of Spikes not being lethal and the level updates? [/h1]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/207140/discussions/2/540742667924447075/]Official feedback thread[/url]

notes.title: r22: SpeedRunners Level Editor Live [updated]
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/7KGPDcT.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/iBqkmbI.jpg[/img]

Hi guys!

Welcome to the SpeedRunners Level Editor in r22! After a closed beta test, we are open for business with creating levels in the Workshop :) 

Even more good news -- everyone who participated in the closed beta will be able to upload their locally stored levels to the Workshop! This post describes in-depth how to use the editor, both in video and text. Making SpeedRunners levels means a lot of work with lead detection, so please pay special attention to how to use that. 

Video tutorial by Casper & Tom:

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2jlXPbVMpvM

[h1]How to use the editor. Please read this carefully.[/h1]

[h1]General controls:[/h1]

Controls depend on which tool you have selected. For example, if you're in the tile tool, these controls will apply only to tiles, to objects, etc.
[list]
[*] CTRL+Left Click = area select
[*] Left Click & drag on corner of selected area = resize (applies to Volumes)
[*] DELETE when area is selected = delete selected area
[*] Hold CTRL while area selected = drag-copy the area
[*] Right Click = bring up options
[*] E and Q = switch between objects in a tool
[*] "[" and "]" = switch layers
[*] 1-2-3-4-5-6-7-8-9 = change brush size
[*] ALT+left-click is delete, useful in the Tile tool to make tunnels
[/list]

[b]Specific tools:[/b]

[h1][T] Tile Tool[/h1]

This is used to create actual tiles. These are the things you run on. Most collidable objects are made with this tool. Useful to know is how to make slopes. Use E to get to a slope tile, and then press 1-9 (depending on the size you like) to scale it. Here using CTRL+Left Click is very useful to copy parts of slopes around. Remember that only white ceilings enable swinging, and they're part of the Tile Tool.

You can also use the Tile tool in background layers.

[h1][O] Objects Tool[/h1]

These are in-game objects. Let's run through them.
[list]
[*] [b]Item Pick-Up[/b] gives you a random pick-up, respawns on a timer
[*] [b]Falltile[/b] disappears on impact and doesn't respawn
[*] [b]Boostpad[/b] gives you boost, can be flipped
[*] [b]Box[/b] is a box. You stumble over it. It respawns.
[*] - has skin variations in Right-Click menu
[*] [b]Spike[/b] kills you on impact.
[*] - has orientation options in Right-Click menu
[*] [b]Rocket Launcher[/b] shoots rockets that kill on impact
[*] [b]Lasers[/b] spin around, make a great light show. Also kill.
[*] - has rotation options in Right-Click menu
[*] [b]Gate[/b] is a gate that you can configure to do things with Triggers
[*] - you can configure it's starting and end-angle in the Right-Click menu
[*] [b]The Trigger[/b] is the area which triggers your gate to rotate. Triggers are volumes you can resize.
[*] - the TriggerID must match the gate you're trying to control
[/list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/RrOfRhR.jpg[/img]

[h1][G] Graphics[/h1]

Each world has it's own set of visuals, and you have full access to them. Seriously. Here is where you want to learn to use Layers (shortcuts "[" and "]").

You can replicate the visuals of any level in SpeedRunners with this tool. Drag around, scale, place objects on different layers.

[h1][C] Checkpoints[/h1]

Controls: place around with the mouse, and use ALT to connect them together.

These are super important! Your levels won't run properly without Checkpoints!

Checkpoints are used to determine who is in the lead in your level. Think of them as laser-distance detectors (that go through walls). You need to know who is in front, and sometimes it's not clear with complicated level geometry.

In open areas, you should draw just one line that ends at a turn section, a junction, whatever. However in tight corridors you should always draw several lines that measure all possible angles of people coming into the corner.

Meanwhile in open areas, it's just a straight line.

[b]First, draw a line that connect your start and finish. This can be a simple collection of straight joined lines that go through the level. Then you can add-on more lines in different corners to measure all possible angles.

We have a little preview generator if you press C. It will use gradients (from dark to light) to fill out the path. Lighter gradient means you're closer to the finish.[/b]

Let's take an example sequence.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/sv4rL00.jpg[/img]

1. Basic implementation. You just make a straight line down. Whoever is furthest DOWN wins. It will work, until you get situations where someone is slightly on the left or right wins, while logically it should be the other person.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/qaZngGw.jpg[/img]

2. Less basic implementation. Make it connect via diagonal lines that touch edges of platforms. The grey stuff you see in the screenshot is the C-button enabled gradient, showing you dead spots.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/uC3Zy3g.jpg[/img]

3. Advanced implementation. This is how you should really do it. Multiple lines track position. If this area is played in Sudden Death, its clear who wins no matter from which side the player drops out of screen.

This takes some patience and is probably the most important aspect of making a map. We spent a lot of time on this system and would love to hear your feedback on improving it!

[h1][V] Volumes[/h1]

Volumes are what we use to control bots. These are areas that you use in specific places to tell bots what to do. You can set an area for a bot to go right, left, jump, use boost, swing, etc. Bots by default just run forward like it's nothing, and we give them hints what to do in specific areas.

This design is very simple but as you noticed pretty flexible. You can tell bots when it's a good idea to use items for example.

[b]Notes:[/b]

Play saved levels in Custom Games -- there's a new icon that shows yours and the levels you subscribed to. 

There are no saws yet. 

We're actively looking for feedback on the editor, so please don't be shy!

[edit]

We've added more features to the editor, checkout the video!

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aWS9LIbZL6U

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JpemOqs2kS0

notes.title: Update r11 - Introducing Bots & Friend Invites
notes.content:
We just published a new build of the game that has two major new features that people have been asking for a lot: [b]bots[/b] and [b]friend invites[/b]!

Here's the full list of changes:
[list]
[*]Added bots
[*]Added friend invites
[*]Added an event calendar
[*]Fixed a bug causing the level to invisible sometimes
[/list]
We've been hearing a lot of players mentioning the lack of a singleplayer mode, so that was always something that we wanted to tackle. Initially, we were thinking about implementing a practice mode where you could do time trials in the multiplayer levels. However, that doesn't sound like a lot of fun, so what we did instead was [b]WE ADDED BOTS![/b]

Secondly, we re-introduced [b]Friend Invites[/b]. This feature used to be in the beta-build, but we had it disabled up until now because it wasn't working properly. Gert-Jan has been working hard on it though and it's finally ready. So you can now get private games going more easily by inviting friends!

So if you start the game and click on Custom Game in the multiplayer menu, you'll see these two new features. Note that you can add bots to any multiplayer game, it doesn't matter if it's a local and/or an online match, but you can only do it through the custom game menu.

Have fun!
-Casper

PS: Don't forget to come back tomorrow for [b]SpeedRapture[/b]; it'll rain rockets for 24 hours!
